description: The proxy and addon modules still read 13 runtime environment variables directly via os.getenv/os.environ (including duplicated boolean parsing and import-time freezes in mitm_addon.py and proxy/wire_log.py) instead of routing through CoherenceSettings.from_env() in settings.py.
goal: Expand CoherenceSettings.from_env() in src/holon_coherence/settings.py to parse and expose WIRE_LOG_MAX_PENDING (default 256), HOLON_WIRE_LOG_BASE_DIR, HOLON_AGENT_ID (default 'agy'), HOLON_ROLE (default 'executor'), AGY_MODEL, HOLON_LOCAL_MODEL, and optional raw WIRE_LOG_DIR override, and migrate all direct os.getenv/os.environ reads in src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/addon.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/wire_record.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py, and src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/route_local_target.py through CoherenceSettings.from_env(). Preserve existing compatibility: settings.wire_log_dir remains a Path (expanded from WIRE_LOG_DIR or ~/.holon/logs for existing tests/test_settings.py), while proxy/wire_log.py and proxy/addon.py resolve WIRE_LOG_DIR dynamically at call time falling back to working-directory-relative DEFAULT_WIRE_LOG_DIR ('.holon/mitm_wire_logs') when WIRE_LOG_DIR is unset so tests/test_mitm_addon.py continues passing unchanged. Add unit tests in tests/test_settings.py and tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py covering the new fields and dynamic env resolution without import-time freezes. Create zero new Python files, keep every modified module strictly within its existing line budget (proxy/wire_log.py <= 200 lines, proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py <= 200 lines, settings.py <= 200 lines), and never modify holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Routing proxy and addon environment reads through CoherenceSettings eliminates duplicated parsing and import-time env freezes without touching container/lifecycle.py or adding new files.
acceptance_criteria: CoherenceSettings.from_env() in src/holon_coherence/settings.py covers WIRE_LOG_MAX_PENDING, HOLON_WIRE_LOG_BASE_DIR, HOLON_AGENT_ID, HOLON_ROLE, AGY_MODEL, HOLON_LOCAL_MODEL, and dynamic WIRE_LOG_DIR override, with unit tests in tests/test_settings.py.

All direct os.getenv/os.environ reads in src/holon_coherence/mitm_addon.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/addon.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/wire_log.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/wire_record.py, src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/serve_dashboard.py, and src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/route_local_target.py route through CoherenceSettings.from_env(), with dynamic env resolution verified in tests/proxy/test_wire_log.py and working-directory-relative wire_log_dir fallback preserved for tests/test_mitm_addon.py.
`uv run pytest` and `uv run task lint` pass with zero docstrings or comments and untouched `module_budgets.json`.
